verdict.rationale: Gram documents an official 'platform-mcp' server that lets an agent working through an MCP client find and add MCP servers, manage toolsets, and read observability data programmatically (gram-docs-7, gram-probe-4), and the CLI can install toolsets as MCP servers (gram-docs-4/5). This covers the discovery story via the MCP protocol itself acting as the documented API, but there is no confirmed general-purpose REST/OpenAPI catalog endpoint (the openapi probe returned 404s) and no independent hands-on proof of the discovery flow itself. Missing for 10: a documented REST/OpenAPI registry endpoint, and third-party/hands-on verification that an agent can actually enumerate servers/tools via the platform MCP server.
